description:
An **IBM Qiskit Fall Fest program **hosted by **QuantumRIT at MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology**, Bengaluru workshops and technical sessions from 27–29 October, followed by an intensive** quantum hackathon on 30–31 October.**

Qiskit Fall Fest is a global, community led series of quantum computing events supported by IBM Quantum. Quantum Week 2026 is QuantumRIT's flagship edition  bringing hands on Qiskit learning, real speakers and a hackathon together on the MSRIT campus in Bengaluru.

Whether you're writing your first quantum circuit or looking to build something ambitious in **24 hours**, the program is designed to meet you where you are: beginner-friendly workshops, deeper technical sessions, and an optional hackathon for those ready to build.
